{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of 'severity' and 'age' by 'arm'
severity_by_arm = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])
age_by_arm = df.groupby('arm')['age'].describe()

# Check if the groups are comparable in terms of severity and age
print('Severity distribution by arm:\n', severity_by_arm)
print('\nAge statistics by arm:\n', age_by_arm)"}
